author: Shabiha Akter
title: Skip Bayless Makes Surprising Allegations on Joel Embiid as He Sits Out Against Orlando Magic - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Joel Embiid (Image Credits: Imagn) Joel Embiid recently underwent a successful appendectomy. The Philadelphia 76ers confirmed the update on social media. But the team did not provide a clear timeline for their franchise star’s return. After missing the matchup against the Milwaukee Bucks , Embiid also sat out the Play-In clash against the Orlando Magic on Wednesday.
Despite the medical explanation, analyst Skip Bayless sparked controversy by suggesting Embiid intentionally chose not to play against Orlando. Speaking on Gil’s Arena, Bayless claimed he heard from a source in Philadelphia that the superstar center has already been medically cleared.
“I have a pretty good source in Philadelphia who told me that Embiid is actually cleared to play but has chosen not to. That’s what I was told. It’s appendicitis, but it went well. These days, they can go in quickly and simply, and he could play if he chose to, ” Bayless said.
Embiid has been sidelined for the 76ers’ last three games before Wednesday. He is in the very early stages of recovery from the injury. However, this controversy comes at the end of a difficult season for Embiid. He has played just 38 games due to various injuries and has also made headlines for the crazy number of missed games throughout his career .
76ers Advance to the Playoffs Without Joel Embiid Philadelphia has already shown it can compete without its MVP center. On Wednesday, the Sixers defeated the Magic 109–97 to move into the first round of the playoffs, where they will face the Boston Celtics.
Joel Embiid (Image Credits: Imagn) Tyrese Maxey led the way with 31 points, six assists, one steal, and one block. Kelly Oubre Jr. and rookie VJ Edgecombe each contributed 19 points. Meanwhile, Paul George added 16 in the victory.
For Orlando, Desmond Bane delivered a standout performance with a game-high 34 points. But it wasn’t enough to stop Philadelphia’s push. Now, the 76ers head into a tough playoff battle against the 2024 champions while continuing to wait for Embiid’s return.
